title: Time Bank Community Participation Agreement
Private Task and One-to-One Interaction Safety Agreement
content:
Private Task and One-to-One Interaction
Safety Agreement
Last Updated: [15/9/2026]
This Agreement applies whenever two or more users interact privately through [App
Name], including an in-person task, home visit, private voice or video call, direct
message, delivery, collection, accompaniment or other one-to-one service.
By accepting a private task and selecting “Agree & Start Task,” each participant agrees
to the following conditions.
1. The Agreed Task Is the Only Authorized Task
Participants may only perform the task described and accepted through the Platform.
A participant must not pressure another person to perform additional services that were
not included in the original task.
Any material change to the task should be confirmed through the Platform before
continuing.
2. Right to Leave or Cancel
Every participant has the right to refuse, stop or leave a task if they feel unsafe,
uncomfortable or unable to continue.
No user may:

● physically prevent another person from leaving;
● threaten another person for cancelling;
● demand payment or Time Credits through intimidation;
● pressure someone to remain in a private location.
Safety takes priority over task completion.
3. Home Visits
Entering another user’s home is permitted only when reasonably necessary for the
accepted task and when the resident has expressly agreed to the entry.
A visiting user must:
● remain only in areas reasonably related to the task;
● leave when requested;
● avoid opening drawers, cabinets, personal devices or private areas without
specific permission;
● not invite an additional person into the property without permission.
The resident may choose to complete a task at the entrance, lobby or another
appropriate public or shared location instead.
4. No Unauthorized Guests
Only the user assigned to the task may attend unless all participants have agreed
through the Platform that another person may be present.
Users must not secretly substitute another person to complete a task.
5. Private Calls and Video Calls
During private voice or video communications, users must not:
● make threats;
● engage in sexual or harassing conduct;
● pressure another user to reveal private information;
● request passwords, banking information or authentication codes;
● make fraudulent financial requests;
● record a private conversation where doing so would violate applicable law or
where required consent has not been obtained.
A user may end a call at any time.

6. Purchases and Errands
Where one user purchases goods for another, the task should clearly state:
● the requested items;
● the expected spending limit;
● the approved payment or reimbursement method; and
● any permitted substitutions.
The assisting user must not make unauthorized purchases.
The requesting user must not pressure another participant to use personal funds beyond
an amount the participant has expressly agreed to advance.
Receipts should be uploaded through the Platform where the feature is available.
7. Personal and Financial Information
During a private task, no participant may request another person’s:
● banking password;
● payment PIN;
● authentication code;
● account password;
● government-account login credentials;
● other credentials that would permit access to sensitive accounts.
Users should only exchange the minimum personal information reasonably required to
complete the task.
8. Connected Watch and Safety Mode
Where supported, an older participant may voluntarily activate Task Safety Mode on the
connected watch.
Depending on the user’s settings and consent, Task Safety Mode may provide features
such as:
● task start and end confirmation;
● duration monitoring;
● fall or unusual inactivity alerts;
● emergency assistance functions;
● check-in notifications;
● limited location sharing during the active task.

Health and location information must be collected, used and shared only in accordance
with applicable law, the Platform Privacy Policy and the user’s permissions.
Another user may not force an older participant to activate or disable health or location
monitoring.
9. Check-In Function
For eligible private tasks, the Platform may ask participants to confirm:
START TASK
and later:
TASK COMPLETED — I AM SAFE
If a task significantly exceeds its expected duration, the Platform may send a safety
check-in.
Failure to respond does not automatically mean that an emergency has occurred.
10. Emergency Assistance
If a participant reasonably believes that someone is in immediate danger, they should
contact the appropriate local emergency service.
The Platform’s emergency features are supplementary safety tools and are not a
replacement for professional emergency services.
11. Prohibited Conduct
The following conduct is strictly prohibited during a private interaction:
● assault or threats;
● theft;
● stalking;
● sexual misconduct;
● fraud or attempted fraud;
● deliberate property damage;
● coercion or extortion;
● financial exploitation;
● impersonation;
● unlawful restraint;
● secretly accessing private accounts, devices or information;

● using the Platform to facilitate criminal activity.
The Platform may immediately suspend an account where there is a reasonable safety
concern while the matter is reviewed.
12. Incident Reporting and Records
Users may report an incident through Report → Safety Incident.
Where permitted by applicable law, the Platform may preserve relevant records such as:
● task details;
● timestamps;
● messages;
● transaction records;
● safety alerts;
● account information;
● task check-in information.
Such information may be disclosed when required by valid legal process or otherwise
permitted by applicable law.
13. No Waiver of Legal Rights
Nothing in this Agreement is intended to require a user to waive rights that cannot
lawfully be waived or to limit responsibility where applicable law prohibits such a
limitation.
Conduct that constitutes a criminal offense remains subject to applicable law regardless
of any action taken by the Platform.
14. Mandatory Acceptance
Before beginning an eligible private task, each participant must separately confirm:
[ ] I understand the task I am accepting.
[ ] I agree to follow the Private Task and One-to-One Interaction Safety Agreement.
[AGREE & START TASK]
Acceptance will be electronically recorded together with the applicable version of this
Agreement, user account and acceptance timestamp.
